Scam trends

Scams to watch for right now

🏦

Bank KYC alerts

Banks never ask you to update KYC through a link in an SMS. Open your bank's official app instead.

🎁

Prize and lottery wins

You cannot win a draw you never entered. Real prizes never ask for a fee first.

🔑

OTP and PIN requests

No genuine bank or delivery service will ask for your OTP, PIN or CVV.

🔗

Fake links and QR codes

Receiving money never needs a PIN or a QR scan. If asked, it is a trick.
